design_invariants: Stable IDs instead of names as keys
Rules data separate from campaign state
All random results can be seeded and logged
Character classes and paths are era-invariant
Class path changes are previewed from axis thresholds and require explicit player confirmation
CEP and XP are separate ledgers

board_game_components.character_board: abilities, HP, Guard, Stress, Resolve, class resource, alignment dials
board_game_components.class_expression_board: three 0-3000 axes or sixteen-slot tracks, CEP bank, candidate-path marker, active-path card, and proficiency band

turn_conversion.edge_burden: roll additional d20 and keep high/low

save_format: A ZIP containing manifest.json, rules-version.json, campaign-state.json, characters/*.json, scenes/*.json, and assets referenced by relative path.

board_game_translation: Race cards store narrative permissions, limitations, habitat tags, and optional bloodline/form selections.
Deity cards store domains, omens, worship practices, warnings, terraforming mandates, and race-association icons.
No race card assigns alignment, class, or compulsory worship.
